fuelAmount.description: The amount of fuel to fill in gallons; this is the additional fuel to add to the tank. This is a float type value.

fuelLevel.description: The fuel level of the vehicle in gallons.

message.content: It looks like the rear tires are a bit under‑inflated (30 PSI). The nearest tire shop is at **456 Oakwood Avenue, Rivermist, 83214**. Head there to get them topped up to the recommended 32 PSI before you hit the road. Safe travels!
